summary: Twelve selected items form a coherent, in-window AI digest spanning news, practitioner, and analysis. Strongest items are well-sourced product/strategy signals (Sakana Fugu launch, ChatGPT bidirectional voice, Zuckerberg/Meta coding-agent pivot, Greg Brockman Codex demo, Replit sales-culture detail, Hugging Face open-source framing, Sakana multi-agent analysis, LLM hidden-world-modeling study, Artificial biopic buyer angle). The Sakana launch and the Sakana-paper analysis are kept as same-topic distinct angles. Three items rely on second-hand attribution or a single low-reach source and are kept with a sourcing caveat rather than replaced: the ridark_eth relay of an attributed Karpathy 'second brain' idea (Karpathy did not post in window), the 0xMovez paraphrase of Andrew Ng's '100% of tasks done by agents' claim, and the Paul__Walsh framing of Anthropic's Persona ID-verification requirement (3.4K views, includes a 'backed by Peter Thiel' assertion). No item is a duplicate requiring removal and no swap improves the set, so all twelve are retained with set-level traceability flags noted.

Each is the best in-window option and is kept with a sourcing caveat; downstream prose should hedge attribution accordingly.
